scripts.build: npm run build --prefix js/packages/truapi && cd playground && yarn build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix js/packages/truapi && cd playground && npx tsc --noEmit --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters
scripts.lint: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && npm run sync-release-versions && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
